text: This program(5 weeks ,summer program) is designed for students who wish to take advantage of their summer vacation to learn not just the Chinese language ,but also various aspests of Chinese cultuer. This program combines three hours of daliy Chinese language instruction along with special activities and cultures.The Chinese language courses has 2 levels ranging from beginner to intermediate .Cultural activities and field trips offer students hands-on experiences with traditional crafts,music ,martial arts.In addition ,special lectures that explore Chinese history ,religion and life help students widen and deepen their knowledge of Chinese culture.
